description: Derived extractions for the Security channel (winlog.channel == 'Security'), projected to ECS over the canonical winlog.* model. Two steps: (1) classify the event — event.category/type/outcome per EventID, with the audit Keywords (0x80200.. success / 0x80100.. failure) as the general outcome; (2) project the winlog.data.* EventData onto ECS entities per EventID family (logon/auth, process/service, account & group management, object/file/registry, WFP network, scheduled task, log-cleared), skipping Windows' absent-value sentinels ('-', '%%NNNN', ::1, 127.0.0.1) and converting the process ids to numbers. The native winlog.data.* stays in place. The human-readable signature/message, the severity bucket and the reason-from-substatus come from the lookup pass, not here.
